title: Episode 2: Sky Dock
description: The hero sails to Sky Dock on Pip Marlow's wind-boat.
captions: A little wind-boat bobs into a harbor of floating docks. The captain grins and tips a very crooked hat.
"Welcome to Sky Dock, {nick}! The boats forgot their routes, and the Dock Bell forgot its song. Care to help?"

title: The Ship's Log
description: Pip finds a clue after the Dock Bell rings again.
captions: The bell rings and the wind-boats set sail, every one on the right route. Pip dances a jig on the dock.
In the lost-and-found, Pip finds an old ship's log with a neat little signature: "M.V." Who left it here?

title: Breezy Run
captions: Breezy Run is a row of tiny docks. Every sail is flapping the wrong way.
Plates on the floor are numbered. Someone wants the boats to line up in order.

title: Weathervane Wob
captions: Wob the weathervane spins like a top and points at the sky, the sea and your hat.
It is not mean. It is dizzy. Dodge the gusts until it slows down.

title: Weathervane Wob
captions: Wob stops spinning and points north, proud as can be.
All the boats line up in a neat row. The Breeze Charm drifts out of the wind.

title: Breezy Run: Breeze Charm
captions: A tiny sail unfurls in the chest: the Breeze Charm.
It hums when the wind is friendly. The way to Rope Loft opens.

title: Rope Loft
captions: Rope Loft is full of ropes in every size. Some are tied to rafters, some to nothing.
Number tags hang from them. The shortest one goes first.

title: Knotty Nell
captions: Knotty Nell the rope-spirit has tied herself into a very tangly knot.
She is not mean, only tangled. Dodge her ends until she wobbles loose.

title: Knotty Nell
captions: Nell untangles with a happy "ploink" and coils up like a cat.
The Rope Charm falls neatly into your hand.

title: Rope Loft: Rope Charm
captions: The Rope Charm rests in the chest, coiled and tidy.
The Vane Valley gate swings open.

title: Vane Valley
captions: Vane Valley is full of wind-vanes pointing every which way.
Turn each one to face the right direction and the valley will remember its wind.

title: Gusty the Gale
captions: Gusty the Gale is a swirly cloud with a very big cheek-puff.
It blows in every direction at once. Dodge until it runs out of puff.

title: Gusty the Gale
captions: Gusty sighs out a soft little breeze and wiggles happily.
A star-shaped charm spins down from the sky.

title: Vane Valley: Vane Charm
captions: The Vane Charm hangs in the chest, always pointing the way.
The way to Crate Cove opens.

title: Crate Cove
captions: Crate Cove is stacked with crates from end to end. Plates on the floor are waiting for two of them.
Push gently. Crates only go forward, never back.

title: Crabsby
captions: Crabsby the crate-crab sidesteps back and forth, counting crates and losing count.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge the bubbles!

title: Crabsby
captions: Crabsby counts all its crates out loud and gets it right.
The Crate Charm bubbles up from the sand.

title: Crate Cove: Crate Charm
captions: The Crate Charm is a little crate with a very big smile.
The path to Foghorn Reef opens.

title: Foghorn Reef
captions: Foghorn Reef is quiet and misty. Glowing posts rise out of the shallow water.
A chime stands nearby. Ring it and watch the order.

title: Foghorn Fran
captions: Fran the foghorn used to sing the whole harbor home. Now she only squeaks.
She is not mean, only squeaky. Dodge the toots!

title: Foghorn Fran
captions: Fran toots one beautiful note, and the fog rolls back like a curtain.
A droplet-shaped charm bobs up from the water.

title: Foghorn Reef: Foghorn Charm
captions: The Foghorn Charm toots a happy note when you shake it.
Only the Tangled Bell is left.

title: The Tangled Bell
captions: The Tangled Bell hangs in the middle of the harbor, wrapped in ropes.
Each rope has a fraction tag. The smallest piece must come first.

title: The Tangled Bell
captions: The Dock Bell has rung so many notes at once that it tied itself in knots.
It is not mean. It is tangled. Dodge the music until it wobbles loose.

title: The Tangled Bell
captions: The ropes fall away and the bell rings one clear, golden note.
Every wind-boat in Sky Dock turns toward the sound, ready to sail home.

title: The Tangled Bell: Bell Charm
captions: The Bell Charm glows in the chest, humming the harbor song.
Captain Pip is waiting at the Dock!
